title: VPF-Core-1K v1.0 metric profile
description: The first fixed DSR-VPF profile for a compact 1 kHz reference workflow. The display transforms are stable diagnostic coordinates, not pass/fail, audibility or sound-quality thresholds.

comparison.distance_metric: missing-data-aware weighted Euclidean distance in normalised profile space

dimensions.label: Speed accuracy
dimensions.raw_quantity: signed playback-speed error relative to the recorded nominal tone
dimensions.admissibility_note: Capture-clock and test-tone accuracy must be documented or bounded.

dimensions.label: Weighted wow and flutter
dimensions.raw_quantity: weighted wow-and-flutter statistic with named weighting, detector and algorithm
dimensions.admissibility_note: Method labels such as IEC, DIN or AES must not be collapsed into one generic field.

dimensions.label: Channel balance
dimensions.admissibility_note: Requires stable level, defined amplitude estimator, analysis window and adequate headroom.

dimensions.label: Stereo separation deficiency
dimensions.required_signal_role: matched left-only and right-only 1 kHz channel-separation tracks
dimensions.admissibility_note: Both directional values, track orientation and averaging rule must be retained.

dimensions.label: Directional crosstalk asymmetry
dimensions.raw_quantity: absolute difference between left-to-right and right-to-left separation
dimensions.required_signal_role: matched left-only and right-only 1 kHz channel-separation tracks
dimensions.admissibility_note: Not interchangeable with average stereo separation.

dimensions.label: Total harmonic distortion
dimensions.raw_quantity: declared per-channel or combined total harmonic distortion
dimensions.admissibility_note: Harmonic limit, bandwidth, windowing, aggregation and frame-quality rule must be declared.
